errors.text_span: По хоризонталната ос са представени пет различни времеви периоди
errors.evidence: The description states that the time periods are on the horizontal axis, but they are on the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: тези категории са разположени в азбучен ред
errors.evidence: The categories are ordered chronologically by time period, with the most recent at the top, not in alphabetical order.
The description claims the vertical axis is labeled with 'години' (years), but the axis has no label, only the category values (the time periods).

errors.text_span: По вертикалната ос са показани процентни стойности
errors.evidence: The description states that the percentage values are on the vertical axis, but they are on the horizontal axis.
The description claims the bars have no shading ('засенчване'), but they clearly have a drop shadow effect.

errors.text_span: и са подредени в низходящ ред по височината си
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in descending order of their length. They are ordered by the time periods on the vertical axis. Additionally, 'височината' (height) is an imprecise term for horizontal bars.
The description incorrectly refers to the scale being on the vertical axis. The percentage scale is on the horizontal axis.
